preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of words in the scroll.
Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty lowercase English letter string (word).
The total length of all words does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of valid ways to remove exactly one character from some subset of words (including none) such that the resulting sequence is lexicographically non-decreasing, modulo 10^9+7. If no such sequence exists, the output is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= len(original_word) <= len(word) + 1 for word in words if word in original_words) and all(len(word) == len(original_word) - 1 for word in words if word not in original_words)
postconditions.description: For each word in the original sequence, either it is unchanged (no character removed) or exactly one character is removed to form a valid word in the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(words[i] <= words[i+1] for i in range(len(words)-1))
postconditions.description: The resulting sequence of words is lexicographically non-decreasing.
